data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 contradicts SRC_013 through inverse rate misapplication: SRC_013 pays 40 hours at base and 7 at OT, while SRC_006 pays all 47 at OT, so they share mechanism (a piecewise threshold model) but contradict each other on the scope of the 1.5× multiplier — SRC_013 confines it to hours >40, SRC_006 extends it to all hours, creating a symmetric boundary error. Refuted if SRC_006's calculation can be reconciled with SRC_013's within any consistent threshold interpretation, or if SRC_006 instead depends on SRC_005's flat-base error rather than contradicting SRC_013.
